confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Belgrade price levels for July 2026; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable, with roughly 20% uncertainty. July hostel and hotel rates are least certain, with roughly 30% uncertainty, because they vary widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine anchors were not directly known, so they were set from the local beer price relationship: a cocktail at roughly twice a draft beer and a wine glass somewhat above a beer. USD values also depend on the dinar-dollar rate, which tracks the euro.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Central and Southeast European capitals such as Sofia, Bucharest, Budapest and Zagreb as rough price-level comparators. Belgrade sits below Western EU capitals, and July accommodation is lifted for summer tourism demand.

anchor_basis.wine_glass: house red or white by the glass (about 150 ml) at a restaurant, about 500 RSD
